OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object

content.text:
The build is green. The change is complete.

## What I did

The create-owner endpoint (`POST /api/owners`) now rejects a body that is missing or blank in any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone`, responding **400** with a JSON body like `{"errors":["city","telephone"]}` naming each offending field.

Following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions (not Spring MVC controllers), I:

1. **`RequireOwnerFields`** (new function) — the pipeline's new first step. Binds `@RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto`, collects the names of every field that is `null` or blank (`isBlank()` catches the whitespace-only telephone case), and throws a checked `OwnerFieldsMissingException` carrying that list. On success it republishes the body as `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>` for the next step.

2. **`OwnerFieldsMissingException`** (new, `extends Exception`) — holds the list of field names so the handler can render them.

3. **`OwnerFieldsMissingExceptionHandler`** + its escalation YAML (`officefloor/escalation/…OwnerFieldsMissingException.yml`) — responds `400` with `{"errors":[...]}`.

4. **`BuildOwner`** — changed from binding `@Valid @RequestBody` to reading the already-validated body via `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` (only one step per pipeline may bind the body).

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `require` step ahead of `build`, making it the pipeline entry point.

All tests pass: `Cp01Tests` (missing city → 400 with `errors` containing `city`; blank telephone → 400; complete owner → 2xx) and the full suite report **BUILD SUCCESS**.
